title_en: A distress indicator system for emergency evacuation
abstract_en: Accordingly, embodiments herein disclose a distress indicator system for emergency evacuation in public spaces The system comprises a Visual and Directional Distress Indicator (VDDI), including an Uninterrupted Bidirectional Distress Indicator (UBDI), comprising at least one visual indicator module that emits a first static visual signal under normal conditions and a second, directionally adaptive visual signal during emergencies to guide occupants toward a safe egress route. The system includes a control panel operably connected to the visual indicator module, configured to receive emergency inputs from a sensing unit and dynamically adjust the evacuation path if the predefined route becomes unsafe. The system further comprises an audio output module that emits synchronized auditory alerts to reinforce visual cues, enhancing evacuation effectiveness. A notification module sends real-time alarms and text alerts to a user interface, notifying administrative personnel of emergency conditions.

title_en: Urban fire intelligent early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent fire early warning, in particular to an intelligent urban fire early warning system which comprises an intelligent urban structure analysis module, a dynamic fire early warning simulation module, a fireproof strategy optimization module and an intelligent environmental impact analysis module. According to the invention, the urban map model is generated by utilizing urban building geographic positions, materials, fire data and building age data, the relevance and characteristics among buildings are deeply analyzed, the fire spreading influence is simulated through a map convolution network, the prediction precision of fire spreading paths and speeds is obviously improved, evacuation difficulty and risk level of the buildings under multiple fire sources are calculated in an assisted manner, a basis is provided for scientifically planning evacuation routes and fireproof isolation areas, emergency response and resource allocation are optimized, meteorological, population dynamics and holiday activity data analysis are integrated, the effect of environmental factors in fire early warning is enhanced, the accuracy and timeliness of early warning are ensured, and the overall efficiency of an urban fireproof system is improved.
assignees: ZIGUANG HUIZHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Personnel evacuation path planning method for disaster prevention and reduction engineering
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of path planning data analysis, and provides a personnel evacuation path planning method for disaster prevention and reduction projects, which is characterized in that the arrival anomaly degree of each period of refuge is analyzed, the arrival anomaly degree consistency of the road section of each period of time passing through the refuge is further analyzed, the load degree of the road section of each period of time reaching the refuge is analyzed, and the congestion degree of the road section of each period of time is obtained; further analyzing the congestion diffusion degree and the congestion progressive expression degree of each time section road section to obtain the congestion involvement degree of each time section road section, and determining the diversion range; and analyzing the degree of the backward rerouting expansion of the road sections of each time period within the rerouting range, determining the expansion rerouting range, and finally determining the recommended rerouting. The method can provide reasonable evacuation route references for the dangerous personnel, reduce unnecessary injuries and confusion, maintain the evacuation order and improve the overall evacuation efficiency.

title_en: Mining area watering cart running control method based on animal avoidance real-time re-planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining area watering cart running control method based on real-time re-planning of animal avoidance, which realizes intelligent obstacle avoidance through multi-mode sensor fusion detection, target recognition of deep learning driving, three-dimensional dynamic path planning, a multi-stage acousto-optic early warning system and self-adaptive speed adjustment, and shortens detection response time and reduces false alarm rate by adopting a radar, a camera, a bionic compound eye vision module and the like. Constraint conditions such as terrain gradient and soil humidity are integrated through an RRT algorithm, continuous processing of path curvature is achieved, the sprinkler can complete path reconstruction without stopping completely under an animal sudden-prevention scene, a hierarchical early warning mechanism triggers three-level acousto-optic warning according to animal approaching degree, a dynamic speed regulation model is matched, and continuity of spraying operation is guaranteed while safety margin is guaranteed. According to the mining area complex environment operation safety and operation efficiency are remarkably improved through the environment interference compensation, the geological disaster early warning interface and the driver behavior simulation unit.
assignees: BEIJING LUKAI ZHIXING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flood prevention platform management method and system for power grid equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a flood control platform management method and system for power grid equipment, which comprise the steps of collecting state parameters and environment parameters of the power grid equipment in real time through a layered architecture, achieving data interaction and instruction synchronization, generating a flood control data pool, constructing an index system comprising equipment vulnerability, environment risk and protection measure effectiveness based on the flood control data pool by adopting a hierarchical analysis method, calculating membership of each index by combining a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model, outputting an evaluation result, triggering an early warning mechanism according to the evaluation result, calling positioning information of an emergency terminal and a path planning template, executing a standardized treatment process, tracking the quantity and state of flood control materials by dynamic monitoring based on the standardized treatment process, optimizing a distribution path based on real-time road condition data of the flood control data pool, receiving feedback data corresponding to the standardized treatment process, analyzing relevance of disaster scenes and equipment faults and material consumption rules, dynamically adjusting the standardized treatment process, and generating a post-disaster evaluation report.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for early warning and prompting sudden surge of foundation pit and prompting evacuation of personnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for warning and prompting sudden surge of a foundation pit and prompting evacuation of personnel, which comprises the following steps: 1) Arranging a pore pressure sensor on the bottom surface of the foundation pit, and collecting pore pressure data; 2) The constructor starts a carried early warning terminal, and the terminal automatically synchronizes the position of the constructor; 3) Calculating the surge resistance of each monitoring point; 4) Calculating a foundation pit early warning coefficient; 5) Marking all points with early warning coefficients larger than 0.9 as dangerous points; 6) Calculating the distance between all constructors and the dangerous point; 7) Sending a signal to a terminal of constructors with the distance of less than 5m from the dangerous point to remind the constructors of evacuation; 8) Judging an evacuation path according to the change trend of the early warning coefficient of monitoring points nearby constructors; 9) Guiding constructors to safely evacuate according to the evacuation path. The invention realizes real-time monitoring and early warning of the sudden surge condition of the foundation pit and provides direction guidance of an evacuation path for constructors in dangerous areas.

title_en: Distributed intelligent emergency fire-fighting and evacuation indicating system and method
abstract_en: The invention designs a novel intelligent emergency fire-fighting and evacuation indicating system and method, which realize the functions of indicating, early warning, alarming and assisting rescue, thereby providing a timely, accurate and dynamic escape route, and belonging to the field of intelligent fire-fighting. The method comprises a data acquisition module, a communication module and an operation module, and comprises the following steps: (1) initializing node parameters according to the space structure inside the building; (2) periodically collecting data and judging the current state of the node; (3) predicting the remaining survival time of the node according to the temperature information of the adjacent node and the node; (4) sending the temperature information and the path information of the node; (5) receiving the adjacent node information, and updating and processing the adjacent node information; (6) planning an escape passage at the node and indicating the escape direction by combining the information of the adjacent node and the node; (7) updating the states of the self node and the adjacent nodes; and has been verified for robustness by physical testing.

title_en: Cloud platform-based automatic inspection deep sea culture disaster avoidance system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic patrol deep sea cultivation disaster avoidance system and method based on a cloud platform. When the unmanned patrol ship is operated, the unmanned patrol ship is cruised along the set route by the ship-borne monitoring module, the positioning module and the auxiliary power supply, and data monitoring is carried out at a navigation stopping point; the cloud platform stores the received data into a cloud database, and can monitor the monitoring data, the unmanned patrol ship positioning information and the navigation route in real time; the forecasting module imports data from the cloud platform to carry out wind disaster assessment and forecasting; judging whether an early warning module is required to be started or not according to a prediction result, planning a safe evacuation route, assisting deep sea farmers to quickly sense ocean wind disasters, and quickly judging safe zones, so that the farmers can perform self-early warning to prevent insufficient preparation when disasters come.

title_en: Transmitter, transmission method, receiver, reception method, and computer program
abstract_en: Transmission of emergency alert information using a broadcasting service in an appropriate manner is achieved. A transmitter  200  (broadcasting station) inserts a wake-up signal as signaling of emergency alert information, describes information including a scale (category), type, occurrence time, and occurrence position of disaster, and version information as a message of emergency alert information, and transmits the message using a packet structure of a physical layer. A simple and inexpensive receiver  300  equipped with only a receiving antenna for broadcasting and a demodulator can receive the message of emergency alert information. An evacuation direction and a map or route to a shelter can be displayed using digital signage or streetlights, and an evacuation route can be instructed using streetlights.

title_en: Novel fire-fighting safety evacuation guiding method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel fire-fighting safety evacuation guiding method, which comprises the following steps of displaying a real plan view of a place on display equipment by utilizing visual and auditory information and transmitting the real plan view to a customer, dividing the place into a plurality of small evacuation areas after calculating according to the number of safety exits, evacuation distances and evacuation widths on the real plan view, displaying a dynamic evacuation route in each evacuation area to the customer, simultaneously replacing a personnel model by using a specific symbol, and moving the dynamic evacuation route from the evacuation areas to a safety position along the demonstrated evacuation route, and displaying the dynamic evacuation route in a voice prompt mode. The invention belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting evacuation, in particular to a novel fire-fighting safety evacuation guiding method based on a fire-fighting theory basis, and automatically displaying the real plan of the place on the safety exit of the electronic equipment in the form of images or videos, and performing warning prompt to assist personnel in nearby escape.

title_en: Blind guiding crutch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a blind guiding crutch which comprises a handle, a key operation panel and a crutch body; the handle is connected with the upper end of the key operation panel; a GPS (Global Position System) antenna used for receiving and sending GPS signals is arranged at the upper end of the handle; a battery module for providing system power source is arranged inside the handle; the crutch body is connected with the lower end of the key operation panel; a system circuit board used for processing data is arranged in the key operation panel; a key switch used for operating an embedded system is arranged on the key operation panel; and a strobe light used for warning is further arranged at the upper end of the crutch body. The technical scheme has the benefits that the use is simple, safety and convenience are ensured, multiple assistance functions such as a travel route guidance, information broadcast and emergency situation positioning can be provided for visually handicapped persons, the life of visually handicapped persons is optimized, equipment integrated on the blind guiding crutch does not affect the normal use of the blind guiding crutch, and the blind guiding crutch has the functions of rain prevention, shock resistance and the like.

title_en: System and method for planning vehicle-mounted path of motor center under area-wide communication
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of multi-vehicle motorized navigation and path planning, and particularly discloses a vehicle-mounted path planning system and method for a motorized center under wide-area communication, which are used for realizing path planning of a task vehicle team, wherein the task vehicle team at least comprises equipment vehicles and operation vehicles; the device comprises a device vehicle, wherein a server device is arranged in the device vehicle, an operation platform is arranged in the operation vehicle, the server device is in communication connection with the operation platform, the operation platform is used for remotely controlling the server device to realize path planning, and early warning or path re-planning is carried out in real time according to the area width communication rate, the travelling deviation and the like in the navigation travelling process. The invention has the characteristics of multi-scene application, complete planning elements and the like, and is particularly suitable for the field of business operation in the movement of the vehicle team.

title_en: Signal appartus for an alarm installtion, alarm installation and method for operating the signal apparatus
abstract_en: Alarm installations in buildings or other environments are used to notify people of particular events, particularly hazards. By way of example, fire alarm installations usually have visual signal generators which, in the event of an alert, bring a hazard situation to the attention of people in a building by means of visual signals. In this case, the aim is to use the visual signals to prompt the people to leave the building via the escape routes. A signal apparatus (1) for an alarm installation (2) is proposed, having a signal generator (3) for outputting a notification signal (6) to the environment of the signal apparatus (1), having a control device (4) for actuating the signal generator (3), and having an activation interface (5) for receiving an activation signal for triggering and/or synchronizing the control apparatus (1), wherein the activation interface (5) is designed to receive a notification signal (6) from a different signal generator than the activation signal.

title_en: Emergency lighting system and lighting device
abstract_en: To make it possible to prevent photosensitivity seizures or the like by synchronizing blinking of a plurality of lighting devices having overlapping lighting areas without exchanging synchronization signals.SOLUTION: Alarms 12 (12-1) to 12 (12-3) are installed in rooms or the like of a residential building 11, and when a fire is detected, output a fire alert and transmit a fire transfer signal. Lighting devices 10 (10-1) to 10 (10-4) receive the fire transfer signal from the alarms 12 (12-1) to 12 (12-3) and start blinking for prompting evacuation guidance. The lighting device 10 (10-1) detects and synchronizes the blinking of the other lighting device 10 (10-2) whose lighting area overlaps during the blinking. For example, if the lighting device 10 (10-1) detects the start of lighting in the blinking of the other lighting device 10 (10-2) during a turn-off time T2 of a blinking cycle T, the lighting device synchronizes its own blinking with the blinking of other lighting device 10 (10-2), by starting lighting with a delay of the blinking cycle T from that lighting start time point.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Intelligent Evacuation Guide Map
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an intelligent evacuation guide map and, more specifically, to an intelligent evacuation guide map, which can mark a point of a fire when the fire has occurred, to drive nearby people to escape away from the point where the fire has occurred or to take first measures, thereby assisting in quick and accurate fire responses. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the intelligent evacuation guide map comprises: a fire recognition unit (1) provided in each room of a building, assigned a unique identifier, and recognizing whether a fire has occurred; evacuation guide maps (2) disposed in the rooms or hallways of the building; fire display lamp (3) arranged in each room picture of the evacuation guide maps (2); and a control unit turning on the corresponding fire display lamps (3) based on the unique identifier of the fire recognition unit (1) recognizing the fire when the fire is recognized by the fire recognition unit (1). Therefore, the intelligent evacuation guide map can match and turn on the fire display lamp (3) corresponding to a room where a fire has occurred in the evacuation guide maps (2) when the fire has occurred in at least one of the rooms, thereby assisting evacuees in checking the scene of the fire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지능형 피난안내도에 관한 것으로, 더 상세하게는 화재가 발생했을 때 화재가 발생한 지점을 표기함으로써 인근에 위치한 사람이 화재가 발생한 지점으로부터 멀어지도록 대피하거나, 초동 조치를 하도록 유도함으로써 빠르고 정확한 화재 대응이 가능하도록 보조하는 지능형 피난안내도에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 실시 예에 따르면, 건물의 각 방별로 구비되어 고유 식별자가 부여되며, 화재발생 여부를 인식하는 화재인식부(1); 상기 건물의 방 또는 복도에 배치되는 대피안내도(2); 상기 대피안내도(2)의 각 방 그림마다 배치되는 화재표시램프(3); 및 상기 화재인식부(1)에서 화재가 인식된 경우, 화재를 인식한 화재인식부(1)의 고유 식별자를 기반으로 그에 대응하는 화재표시램프(3)를 점등시키는 제어부;를 포함하여, 상기 각 방 중 하나 이상의 방에서 화재가 발생했을 때, 상기 대피안내도(2)에서 화재가 발생한 방에 해당하는 화재표시램프(3)를 대응시켜 점등함으로써 대피자가 화재발생 현장을 확인하도록 보조하는, 지능형 피난안내도를 제공한다.

title_en: Prevention system in huge tunnel using rfid
title_ko: Ｒｆｉｄ를 이용한 장대터널 내 소방장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system and a method for fire fighting in a huge tunnel are provided, which can secure fire fighting location quickly and exactly when a fire occurs in a huge tunnel. CONSTITUTION: A method for fire fighting in a huge tunnel comprises: a step(S1) of sensing whether a fire occurs in a tunnel or not through sensors; a step(S2) of sensing fire in the tunnel and informing of a spot where a fire occurs in the tunnel; a step(S3) of transmitting an operation signal to a CC-TV camera; a step(S4) of moving to an RFID tag and stopping in a fire occurring spot; a step(S5) of adjusting the location of a fire engine to synchronize a fire occurring area and a fire extinguishing agent spray area; and a step(S6) of spraying fire extinguishing agent.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 RFID를 이용한 장대터널 내 소방 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로 외부에서의 접근이 아닌 장대터널 내 구비된 자율 주행성 소방대차를 이용한 소방 시스템으로서 장대터널 내에서 발생한 화재발생지점에 신속히 이동시켜 정확한 소방위치를 확보하고, 화재발생에 대한 신속한 진압으로부터 인명, 차량 및 시설물의 피해를 최소화하며, 화재진압과 동시 제어부와 연계된 장대터널 내 환기장치를 가동하거나 그 출력을 높여 장대터널 내 공기의 유동 속도를 향상시켜 화재연기로 인한 2차 인명피해를 줄일 수 있고, 장대터널 내 대피장치(시선 유도등)를 작동시켜 장대터널 내 머무르는 대피자가 쉽게 대피경로를 확보할 수 있도록 하며, 장대터널에 설치된 상황전달 장치(전광판)를 작동시켜 장대터널 내로 진입하고자 하는 주변차량에 대한 진입을 통제시킬 수 있으며, 더불어 주변 관리시스템(소방서, 경찰서, 교통센터, 방송센터 등)으로 신속한 연락망을 구축할 수 있는 산업 상 크게 기여할 수 있는 발명인 것이다. 
     이를 위한 본 발명은 장대터널 내 화재 판단용 감지부와, 화재발생지점 알림용 RFID 태그 및 화재발생지점으로 자동 추적 주행하는 소방대차, 및 상기 소방대차의 주행신호를 발생시키고, 화재발생지점에 도달한 소방대차의 CCTV 카메라로부터 전송되는 영상정보를 출력하고, 이 영상정보를 기반으로 하는 소방대차 미세조정신호 및 소방대차에 대한 소화액분사 작동신호를 발생시키는 제어부로 구성되는 RFID를 이용한 장대터널 내 소방 시스템에 관한 것을 그 기술적 요지로 한다.

title_en: Transmission device, transmission method, reception device, reception method, and computer program
abstract_en: This invention makes use of a broadcasting service to suitably convey emergency-warning information. A transmission device (200) (broadcasting station) inserts emergency-warning-information signaling in the form of an activation signal and uses a physical-layer packet structure to convey an emergency-warning-information message that indicates the scale (category) of a disaster, the type of the disaster, the time of the disaster, the location of the disaster, version information, and the like. Even a simple, inexpensive reception device (300) provided with just a broadcast reception antenna and a demodulator can receive said emergency-warning-information message. Digital signage or street lights can be used to display directions in which to evacuate or maps or routes to evacuation areas, and street lights can be used to indicate evacuation routes.

title_en: A gas leak alert and Evacuation aid
title_ko: IoT 기반의 가스유출알림 및 피난유도 보조 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gas leakage notification and evacuation guidance auxiliary system based on IoT, which is to solve a problem and existing equipment is large and can not assist evacuation by assisting guidance of evacuation when gas leakage occurs. The gas leakage notification and evacuation guidance auxiliary system of the present invention comprises: a gas sensor unit including a gas sensor and a temperature/humidity sensor to detect gas leakage and to transmit a signal; a control unit including a processor such as an MCU for receiving a signal from the gas sensor to transmit the same; a network unit including a network system such as a zigbee capable of receiving data from the control unit and transmitting the same to a mobile transmission unit; a mobile transmission unit having Bluetooth for display through a smartphone; and an evacuation guidance assistance notifying unit for performing guidance to an escape route with an LED to provide notification so as to assist evacuation guidance when gas leakage occurs. Therefore, evacuation guidance is assisted when gas leakage occurs so an effect of solving a problem that existing equipment is large and can not assist evacuation is provided.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 IoT 기반의 가스유출알림 및 피난유도 보조 시스템에 관한 것으로서 가스유출이 발생했을 시 대피를 유도할 수 있게 보조해주게 하도록 함으로써 기존의 장비가 크고  대피를 보조할 수 없는 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 가스유출시스템에 있어서 가스유출을 탐지하고 신호를 보내줄 수 있게 가스센서와 온습도센서 로 구성한 가스센서부, 가스센서부로 부터 신호를 받아서 전달 시켜주는  MCU와 같은 프로세서로 구성된 한 제어부, 제어부로 부터 데이터를 받아 모바일 전송부로 전송할 수 있게 해주는  지그비와 같은 네트워크 시스템으로 구성된 한 네트워크부, 스마트폰을 통해 앱으로 표출할 수 있게   블루투스로 구성한 모바일 전송부, 가스유출이 발생했을 시 대피유도를 보조할 수 있도록 알림을 주게 LED로 길 탈출로를 유도하는 것으로 구성한 대피유도보조알림부로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 가스유출이 발생했을 시 대피를 유도할 수 있게 보조해주게 하도록 함으로써 기존의 장비가 크고  대피를 보조할 수 없는 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Systems and methods for providing evacuation monitoring and assistance
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are apparatuses and methods for providing evacuation guidance. An implementation may determine a last known location of a person in an environment under evacuation. An implementation may calculate, for the person, an exit time for evacuating the environment based on an amount of time needed by the person to exit the environment starting from the last known location. An implementation may monitor whether the person has evacuated the environment. An implementation may determine whether a current time has passed the exit time. An implementation may transmit an alert to a device of the person in response to determining that the current time has passed the exit time and that the person has not evacuated the environment.

title_en: System and method for providing evacuation monitoring and assistance
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are apparatuses and methods for providing evacuation guidance. An implementation may comprise identifying a person physically present in an environment requiring an evacuation. The implementation further includes detecting, using at least one sensor in the environment, a last known location of the person. The implementation further includes calculating an exit time for evacuating the environment based on the last known location. The implementation further includes monitoring, using at least one sensor located at an egress point of the environment, whether the person has evacuated the environment. The implementation further includes determining whether a current time has passed the exit time. The implementation further includes transmitting an alert to a device of the respective person in response to determining that the current time has passed the exit time and that the person has not evacuated the environment.

title_en: A kind of intelligent building video monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of intelligent building video monitoring system, including：Monitoring device, including monitor component, and infrared sensor and smoke sensor device, detect simultaneously output monitoring signal, infrared acquisition signal and Smoke Detection signal respectively；Control device, is connected with monitoring device signal, including monitor screen and console, console output processing signal；Warning device, is connected with control device, including sound-light alarm installations and communication component.Monitoring device can carry out each location point in building real time monitoring actively and passively, while be also responsible for safety monitor；When running into fire behavior, the monitor screen of control device can monitor fire constantly, Security Personnel plans escape route according to fire information and processing signal is sent to sound-light alarm installations, sound-light alarm installations will be moved into designated position guiding personnel escape, fire behavior is sent to fire-fighting by warning device at the same time, and escape route is sent to building user, assist building user escape.

title_en: Forest fire evacuation method and sensor
abstract_en: The application discloses a forest fire evacuation method and a sensor, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring fire information, and scattering a plurality of sensors into a fire area according to the fire information; the method comprises the steps of acquiring position data of a fireman in real time, acquiring data of surrounding sensors according to the position data, sending an alarm when the data of the sensors within the safety distance of the fireman reaches a preset early warning threshold value and the distance from the sensors to the fireman is reduced, forming an optimal escape route according to the position points of the sensors with the data lower than the preset early warning threshold value, and sending the optimal escape route to a display of a terminal held by the fireman to enable the fireman to evacuate according to the optimal escape route. The application solves the technical problem that the ground center can not effectively assist and command firemen according to the field conditions so as not to provide enough information safety guarantee for the firemen.

title_en: Evacuation guidance system for fire escape assistance
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of evacuation guidance in fire scene, and particularly relates to an evacuation guidance system for fire escape assistance, which comprises a building body, wherein floor plates are arranged in the building body at equal intervals, the outer walls of the bottoms of the floor plates are fixedly connected with direction lamps, an alarm controller and a smoke-sensitive fire detector, the smoke-sensitive fire detector is connected with the alarm controller through a lead, and the direction lamps are connected to the alarm controller through leads. According to the invention, through the arranged alarm controller, the smoke-sensitive fire detector and the red-yellow-green vertical direction lamps, people can be helped to quickly and effectively avoid smoke, early warning is carried out on toxic smoke, a relatively safe evacuation escape route is found, unnecessary life casualties generated when people evacuate and escape to a staircase can be reduced, whether trapped people evacuate downwards or stay on the spot to wait for rescue can be guided in the first time, and the life safety of the people is ensured to the maximum extent.

title_en: Building fire safety real-time monitoring and digital intelligent management and control system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building fire-fighting safety real-time monitoring and digital intelligent control system and a method, which belong to the field of fire-fighting safety digital intelligent. After receiving floor temperature and smoke information, the intelligent fire-fighting safety management and control instrument for the building invokes an embedded model to analyze and evaluate fire conditions, fire source positions, smoke flow directions, fire loads, intensity and fire scene building structure fire resistance, sends out floor fire escape path guidance and fire scene safety warning, and simultaneously sends data to a fire-fighting safety management assistant and a floor evacuation path guidance intelligent device. The intelligent floor evacuation path guiding device receives information of the intelligent fire safety management and control instrument of the building and lights up the evacuation path guiding directional lamp. The fire safety management assistant receives fire information sent by the intelligent building fire safety management and control instrument and assists fire safety management of building fire firefighters.

title_en: Transmission device, transmission method, reception device, reception method, and computer program
abstract_en: This invention makes use of a broadcasting service to suitably convey emergency-warning information. A transmission device (200) (broadcasting station) inserts emergency-warning-information signaling in the form of an activation signal and uses a physical-layer packet structure to convey an emergency-warning-information message that indicates the scale (category) of a disaster, the type of the disaster, the time of the disaster, the location of the disaster, version information, and the like. Even a simple, inexpensive reception device (300) provided with just a broadcast reception antenna and a demodulator can receive said emergency-warning-information message. Digital signage or street lights can be used to display directions in which to evacuate or maps or routes to evacuation areas, and street lights can be used to indicate evacuation routes.

title_en: A kind of subway station intelligent emergent evacuation indication system and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention provides a kind of subway station intelligent emergent evacuation indication system and method, including comprehensive survey module, central control module and multi information intelligence indicating module；The comprehensive survey module carries out real-time monitoring to the subway station region Nei Ge, and the environmental data that will acquire is sent to the central control module immediately；The central control module, the environmental data is analyzed and processed, whether reach danger threshold according to each area monitoring data, judge region on fire, flue gas diffusion zone, and real-time update is carried out to emergency evacuation lines according to judging result, and send evacuation instruction to the multi information intelligence indicating module；The multi information intelligence indicating module is instructed according to the evacuation, carries out guiding in real time to crowd evacuation in subway station.It can quickly find underground fire hazard and real-time intelligent planning evacuation route, effectively avoid evacuation crowd from being strayed into fire smoke sprawling region during evacuation, greatly improve evacuation efficiency and evacuation safety degree.

title_en: Digital twin evacuation early warning method for barrier-free channel of booster station
abstract_en: The application discloses a digital twin evacuation early warning method for a barrier-free channel of a booster station, which effectively solves the problem of path planning misalignment caused by insufficient fusion of multisource perception data. Through the spatial data integration of the digital twin model, the usable state and disaster influence range of the barrier-free facilities can be accurately identified. The dynamic path planning algorithm continuously optimizes the evacuation route in the disaster evolution process, and prevents personnel from entering the affected dangerous area. The multi-mode instruction generation mechanism ensures that people with different physiological characteristics can obtain adaptive evacuation guidance, the detention risk caused by single information transmission mode is reduced, the real-time state monitoring and path updating function further improves the response speed and reliability of the emergency evacuation system, the geometric dimension and the space coordinates of facilities are acquired excessively accurately, the consistency of a virtual model and an actual environment is ensured, and the data support is provided for evaluating the availability of the facilities in a disaster environment by configuring material characteristics and accessibility parameters.

title_en: Mine disaster early warning method and system based on machine learning
abstract_en: The application relates to a mine disaster early warning method and system based on machine learning. The method comprises the steps of detecting node response time based on a periodic heartbeat signal to obtain a failure node list, actively sending the periodic heartbeat signal by a control node to indicate all nodes to feed back the node response time, wherein the failure node list is used for representing failed nodes in a network topology graph, calculating an optimal path through a Q-learning algorithm based on the failure node list and the real-time network topology graph to obtain an optimal communication path table, synchronizing early warning information through improvement Raft protocol based on the optimal communication path table to obtain a global consistent early warning information set, planning an optimal escape route based on the global consistent early warning information set and a three-dimensional digital twin model of a mine to obtain an early warning instruction set, and sending the early warning instruction set to an escape terminal. The method can achieve the effect of rapidly agreeing the early warning information in the topological network and dynamically adjusting the escape route.

title_en: Automatic tactile, audible and visual feedback navigation assisted intelligent electronic shoe system
abstract_en: Intelligent electronic shoes and garments having controller automation features, methods for manufacturing/operating such shoes and garments, and control systems for performing the automation features of such shoes and garments are presented. A method for operating an Intelligent Electronic Shoe (IES) includes receiving, for example, via a controller, location data of a user from a GPS satellite service through a wireless communication device. The controller also receives location data of the target object or location, such as a virtual shoe hidden at a virtual point, for example, from a back-end server level computer or other remote computing node. The controller retrieves or predicts path planning data including a derived route for traversing from a user location to a target location within the geographic area. The controller then sends command signals to a navigational alert system mounted on the IES' shoe structure to output visual, audible and/or tactile cues to guide the user along the derived route.

title_en: Signal apparatus for an alarm installation, alarm installation and method for operating the signal apparatus
abstract_en: Alarm installations in buildings or other environments are used to notify people of particular events, particularly hazards. By way of example, fire alarm installations usually have visual signal generators which, in the event of an alert, bring a hazard situation to the attention of people in a building by means of visual signals. In this case, the aim is to use the visual signals to prompt the people to leave the building via the escape routes. A signal apparatus ( 1 ) for an alarm installation ( 2 ) is proposed, having a signal generator ( 3 ) for outputting a notification signal ( 6 ) to the environment of the signal apparatus ( 1 ), having a control device ( 4 ) for actuating the signal generator ( 3 ), and having an activation interface ( 5 ) for receiving an activation signal for triggering and/or synchronizing the control apparatus ( 1 ), wherein the activation interface ( 5 ) is designed to receive a notification signal ( 6 ) from a different signal generator than the activation signal.

title_en: Personnel evacuation path planning method for disaster prevention and reduction engineering
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of path planning data analysis, and provides a personnel evacuation path planning method for disaster prevention and reduction projects, which is characterized in that the arrival anomaly degree of each period of refuge is analyzed, the arrival anomaly degree consistency of the road section of each period of time passing through the refuge is further analyzed, the load degree of the road section of each period of time reaching the refuge is analyzed, and the congestion degree of the road section of each period of time is obtained; further analyzing the congestion diffusion degree and the congestion progressive expression degree of each time section road section to obtain the congestion involvement degree of each time section road section, and determining the diversion range; and analyzing the degree of the backward rerouting expansion of the road sections of each time period within the rerouting range, determining the expansion rerouting range, and finally determining the recommended rerouting. The method can provide reasonable evacuation route references for the dangerous personnel, reduce unnecessary injuries and confusion, maintain the evacuation order and improve the overall evacuation efficiency.
